title: Their throw-in
text: The other team has a throw-in near your box. The nearest attacker is close to you.
tip: Set pieces count too. Switch on.

options.text: Get tight and goal-side of the nearest attacker
options.why: A throw-in is an easy pass for them, so make it hard to receive.
Your attacker can get free while you're looking.

options.text: Stand back to give yourself room
options.why: They can receive and turn easily.
